title: Kirby Problem 4.125
exact_target: Can a cusped finite-volume oriented hyperbolic four-manifold fail to admit a spin structure?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 3001 (KP-4.125). CC BY 4.0.

R. İnanç Baykur, Robion C. Kirby and Daniel Ruberman (eds.), \emph{K3: A New Problem List in Low-Dimensional Topology}, Mathematical Surveys and Monographs 295, American Mathematical Society (2026), Problem 4.125, author preliminary version.

Stefano Riolo and Edoardo Rizzi, \emph{A cusped hyperbolic 4-manifold without spin structures}, arXiv:2510.12657v2 (2026; first posted 2025), abstract and main theorem. The manuscript supplies the requested example.
